title: Early socio-emotional skills and adolescent offending: evidence from administrative data
title_zh: 早期社会情感技能与青少年犯罪：来自行政数据的证据
title_primary: 早期社会情感技能与青少年犯罪：来自行政数据的证据
title_secondary: Early socio-emotional skills and adolescent offending: evidence from administrative data
authors: Garcia, Paul
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines how early socio-emotional skills shape adolescent offending in England and the school pathways through which they operate. I use administrative data linking teacher-reported child development assessments at age five to school and criminal justice records through age 17. Factor analysis of these assessments reveals two underlying domains of early difficulty, cognitive and socio-emotional. Both raise the probability of a caution or conviction between ages 11 and 17 by around 15%, but through distinct channels. Cognitive difficulties act primarily through academic attainment, while socio-emotional difficulties operate largely through school exclusions yet retain a substantial direct effect, accounting for around 40% of the total effect. The socio-emotional effect is robust to unobserved school and family heterogeneity and shapes both the type and frequency of offending. Statutory support for learning difficulties and social care services attenuates the associations between early skill deficits and offending. These findings suggest that differentiated support is needed based on the type of difficulty.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了早期社会情感技能如何塑造英格兰青少年的犯罪行为及其通过学校路径发挥作用的机制。我利用行政数据，将五岁时教师评估的儿童发展结果与至17岁的学校及刑事司法记录相链接。对这些评估的因子分析揭示了早期困难的两个潜在领域：认知与社会情感。两者均使11至17岁期间受到警告或定罪的概率提高约15%，但通过不同的渠道发挥作用。认知困难主要通过学业成就起作用，而社会情感困难则主要通过学校排斥产生影响，但仍保留显著的直接效应，约占总效应的40%。社会情感效应在考虑未观测到的学校与家庭异质性后依然稳健，并影响犯罪类型及频率。针对学习困难和社会关怀服务的法定支持减弱了早期技能缺陷与犯罪行为之间的关联。这些发现表明，根据困难类型需要提供差异化的支持。

title: Integrating Threatened Biodiversity in Monetary Ecosystem Accounting: Choice Experiments and Simulated Exchange Values
title_zh: 将受威胁生物多样性纳入货币化生态系统核算：选择实验与模拟交换价值
title_primary: 将受威胁生物多样性纳入货币化生态系统核算：选择实验与模拟交换价值
title_secondary: Integrating Threatened Biodiversity in Monetary Ecosystem Accounting: Choice Experiments and Simulated Exchange Values
authors: Jose L. Oviedo, Pablo Campos, Alejandro Caparrós, Gonzalo M. Arroyo, Andrés De La Cruz
abstract: We present a valuation framework for measuring the non-market net operating surplus associated with threatened wild species preservation for monetary ecosystem accounting . We use the Simulated Exchange Value ( SEV ) method, which estimates the maximum benefit that could be internalized in a hypothetical market using the demand simulated from a choice experiment, a given market supply, and an assumed market structure. The choice experiment estimates willingness to pay (WTP), in addition to current tax-funded costs, for achieving different stock levels of wild species across threat categories defined by the International Union for Conservation of Nature Red List. We apply this framework to the valuation of threatened waterbird species preservation in the coastal wetlands of the southwestern Iberian Peninsula. The results show that WTP increases as the number of threatened species decreases, with the critically endangered species generating the highest WTP and no statistically significant differences between vulnerable and endangered species. Based on our preferred model, we estimate a SEV of the net operating surplus of €2,850 per hectare per year for the current stock levels of threatened waterbird species. The equivalent variation estimated for the same stock level is €4,108 per hectare per year.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种估值框架，用于衡量与受威胁野生物种保护相关的非市场净经营盈余，以服务于货币化生态系统核算。我们采用模拟交换价值（SEV）方法，该方法通过选择实验模拟的需求、给定的市场供给以及假定的市场结构，估算在假设市场中可内部化的最大收益。该选择实验估算了除当前税收资助成本之外，为实现国际自然保护联盟（IUCN）红色名录所定义的不同威胁类别野生物种存量水平而支付的意愿（WTP）。我们将此框架应用于伊比利亚半岛西南部沿海湿地受威胁水鸟物种保护的估值。结果显示，随着受威胁物种数量的减少，WTP增加，其中极危物种产生的WTP最高，而易危物种与濒危物种之间无统计学显著差异。基于我们的优选模型，我们估算出当前受威胁水鸟物种存量水平的净经营盈余SEV为每公顷每年2850欧元。同一存量水平下估算的等价变差为每公顷每年4108欧元。

title: Bank Runs With and Without Bank Failure
title_zh: 银行挤兑与银行倒闭：有与无
title_primary: 银行挤兑与银行倒闭：有与无
title_secondary: Bank Runs With and Without Bank Failure
authors: Sergio A. Correia, Stephan Luck, Emil Verner
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the causes and consequences of bank runs. By applying large language models to historical newspapers, we create a comprehensive database of bank runs in U.S. history with information on 3,984 runs on individual banks from 1863 to 1934. Our novel data allow us to establish that runs are considerably more likely in weak banks but also occur in strong banks, especially in response to negative news about the real economy or the broader banking system. However, runs typically only result in failure for banks with poor fundamentals. Strong banks survive runs through various mechanisms, including signaling strength, interbank cooperation, and temporary suspension. At the local level, runs on banks with poor fundamentals translate into substantially larger declines in deposits, lending, and manufacturing activity than runs on strong banks. Our findings imply that poor fundamentals are central to explaining both when runs occur and when they have severe economic effects, tempering the view that small shocks can generate discontinuous jumps to bad equilibria through self-fulfilling run dynamics.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了银行挤兑的成因与后果。通过将大语言模型应用于历史报纸，我们构建了一个涵盖美国历史上银行挤兑事件的综合数据库，包含1863年至1934年间3984次针对单个银行的挤兑信息。这一全新数据使我们得以证实：挤兑更可能发生在弱势银行，但也会发生在强势银行，尤其是当实体经济或整个银行体系出现负面消息时。然而，挤兑通常仅导致基本面较差的银行倒闭。强势银行则通过多种机制存活，包括释放实力信号、银行间合作以及临时暂停营业。在地方层面，基本面较差的银行遭遇挤兑后，其存款、贷款和制造业活动的下降幅度显著大于强势银行遭遇挤兑的情况。我们的研究结果表明，基本面薄弱是解释挤兑何时发生以及何时产生严重经济影响的核心因素，这削弱了“小冲击可通过自我实现的挤兑动态引发向不良均衡的非连续跳跃”这一观点。

title: Do Workfare Programs Live Up to Their Promises? Experimental Evidence from Côte d’Ivoire
title_zh: 工作福利计划是否兑现了承诺？来自科特迪瓦的实验证据
title_primary: 工作福利计划是否兑现了承诺？来自科特迪瓦的实验证据
title_secondary: Do Workfare Programs Live Up to Their Promises? Experimental Evidence from Côte d’Ivoire
authors: Bertrand, Marianne, Crépon, Bruno, Marguerie, Alicia, Premand, Patrick
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study contemporaneous and post-program impacts of a public works program, which provides urban youth seven months of employment at the formal minimum wage with complementary training on entrepreneurship or job search. During the program, we find limited impacts on employment, but a shift toward wage jobs, higher earnings and savings, as well as positive changes in work habits, behaviors, and well-being. After the program, we find no lasting impact on employment or behaviors, with only limited gains in earnings stemming from independent activities. Using machine learning to analyze heterogeneity, we show that alternative targeting approaches can substantially improve welfare.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一项公共工程项目在实施期间及结束后的影响。该项目为城市青年提供为期七个月的正式最低工资就业，并辅以创业或求职培训。在项目实施期间，我们发现其对就业的影响有限，但促使就业向工资性工作转移，提高了收入和储蓄，并在工作习惯、行为及福祉方面产生了积极变化。项目结束后，就业或行为方面未发现持久影响，仅从独立活动中获得有限的收入增长。通过机器学习分析异质性，我们表明替代性的目标定位方法可以显著改善福利。

title: Monopolistic Data Dumping
title_zh: 垄断性数据倾销
title_primary: 垄断性数据倾销
title_secondary: Monopolistic Data Dumping
authors: Eliaz, Kfir, Spiegler, Ran
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: A profit-maximizing monopolist curates a database for users seek- ing to learn a parameter. There are two user types: "Nowcasters" wish to learn the parameter's current value, while "forecasters" target its long-run value. Data storage involves a constant marginal cost. The monopolist designs a menu of contracts described by fees and data-access levels. The profit-maximizing menu o¤ers full access to historical data, while current data is fully provided to nowcasters but may be withheld from forecasters. Compared to the social optimum, the monopolist keeps too much historical data, too little current data, and may store too much data overall.
abstract_zh: 一个追求利润最大化的垄断者为试图学习某个参数的用户构建数据库。用户分为两类："即时预测者"希望了解该参数的当前值，而"长期预测者"则关注其长期值。数据存储涉及恒定的边际成本。垄断者设计了一套由费用和数据访问权限组成的合同菜单。利润最大化的菜单提供对历史数据的完全访问，同时当前数据被完全提供给即时预测者，但可能对长期预测者有所保留。与社会最优相比，垄断者保留了过多的历史数据、过少的当前数据，并且整体上可能存储了过多的数据。

title: Organizational Incentives and the Returns to Technology Adoption
title_zh: 组织激励与技术采纳的回报
title_primary: 组织激励与技术采纳的回报
title_secondary: Organizational Incentives and the Returns to Technology Adoption
authors: Achyuta Adhvaryu, Smit Gade, Piyush Gandhi, Teresa Molina, Anant Nyshadham
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Misaligned incentives within organizations may explain why firms fail to adopt or fully benefit from productive technologies. We conducted a randomized controlled trial in Indian garment factories in which units received an anonymous worker-management communication technology, this technology paired with incentives for HR managers to communicate effectively with workers, or neither (control). We find that the technology alone had no impacts relative to control. But pairing the technology with HR incentives increased productivity by 5%, reduced absenteeism by 13%, and raised worker earnings by 3%. Impacts were driven by greater HR responsiveness and increased worker reporting of production-related issues.
abstract_zh: 组织内部的激励错位可能解释了企业为何未能采纳或充分受益于高效技术。我们在印度服装工厂开展了一项随机对照试验，其中部分工厂获得匿名员工-管理层沟通技术，部分工厂在技术基础上附加对人力资源经理有效沟通的激励措施，其余工厂则未获得任何干预（对照组）。研究发现，仅提供技术本身相较于对照组未产生显著影响。但将技术与人力资源激励相结合后，生产率提升5%，缺勤率降低13%，工人收入增加3%。这些影响源于人力资源响应度的提高以及工人对生产相关问题报告频率的增加。

title: Interactions of behavioral interventions across pro-environmental domains: A natural field experiment
title_zh: 跨环保行为领域的行为干预互动：一项自然田野实验
title_primary: 跨环保行为领域的行为干预互动：一项自然田野实验
title_secondary: Interactions of behavioral interventions across pro-environmental domains: A natural field experiment
authors: Maoliang Ling, Yiming Liu, Lin Xu, Juntao He
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Despite the proliferation of behavioral nudges across pro-environmental domains, it remains unclear whether and how these interventions interact. We study nudge interactions through a two-year natural field experiment, in which two Home Report-type social-comparison interventions—targeting household waste sorting (HWSR) and water conservation (HWR), respectively—were implemented either independently or jointly. The HWSR improved waste sorting regardless of whether the HWR was also applied. However, while the HWR reduced water consumption when implemented alone, it became ineffective when combined with the HWSR. This crowding-out effect eliminates the welfare gains from the HWR under pre-existing water tariffs that weakly internalize the environmental costs of water use. Additional evidence suggests that crowding out was most pronounced in communities with high social capital and without monetary rewards for waste sorting, and that the HWSR strengthened recipients’ moral-normative beliefs in these communities. We discuss potential crowding-out mechanisms related to attention and preferences.

title: Bureaucratic norms and dynamic Bayesian persuasion
title_zh: 官僚规范与动态贝叶斯说服
title_primary: 官僚规范与动态贝叶斯说服
title_secondary: Bureaucratic norms and dynamic Bayesian persuasion
authors: Yihang Zhou
official: 官方在线 September  · 来源：RSS
abstract: A developer seeks to persuade a sequence of two short-tenured officials to award her a contract. Officials maximize social welfare, and the second official follows a bureaucratic norm requiring reliance only on evidence presented directly to him. Thus, Bayesian inference is restricted when the first official defers the decision, because the second does not observe the first official’s evidence. The first official can exploit this restriction to induce more informative experiments. When the static value of persuasion is zero for the bureaucracy but positive for the developer, two outcomes arise: either the first official decides immediately with more information, increasing social welfare, or delay occurs, with delay costs offsetting informational benefits. In both cases, the developer’s expected payoff is lower than under static persuasion. With unrestricted inference, an intuitive PBE replicates the static outcome, so the norm may increase social welfare and never reduces it relative to the static benchmark.

title: Sustainable Livestock Decisions in a Post‐Conflict Frontier: Evidence From Colombia's Orinoquía
title_zh: 后冲突前沿地区的可持续畜牧业决策：来自哥伦比亚奥里诺基亚地区的证据
title_primary: 后冲突前沿地区的可持续畜牧业决策：来自哥伦比亚奥里诺基亚地区的证据
title_secondary: Sustainable Livestock Decisions in a Post‐Conflict Frontier: Evidence From Colombia's Orinoquía
authors: Hernando Flórez‐Díaz, Emiliano Lopez Barrera, Adriana María Molina‐Romero, Diana Elisa Correa‐Pinilla, Carlos Fontanilla‐Díaz
abstract: The Orinoquía region is one of Colombia's principal agricultural frontiers and has been shaped by long‐standing armed‐conflict dynamics that continue to influence land governance, producer incentives, and investment decisions. Efforts to promote sustainable cattle production emphasize two key practices: sustainable pasture management (including rotational grazing systems) and ecologically appropriate stocking rates. However, their adoption varies widely because of institutional, economic, and biophysical constraints. This study applies a dual binary choice framework to examine the adoption decisions associated with these two practices and to assess whether they operate sequentially or independently. Results show that tenure security, measured through formal landownership, is strongly associated with the adoption of sustainable pasture management. In contrast, access to technical assistance is negatively associated with adoption, suggesting issues of program quality, targeting, or reverse causality. Older and more experienced producers are less likely to adopt, indicating path dependence. For stocking‐rate decisions, rotational and alternating grazing systems exhibit lower probabilities of meeting sustainable thresholds, likely reflecting implementation challenges in extensive systems. Larger finishing areas also tend to be managed less sustainably, and descriptive evidence suggests that unsustainable stocking in our sample is more frequently associated with understocking than overstocking, with 239 producers (70%) below 1 animal per hectare. These findings illustrate how structural and institutional conditions, including those linked to conflict legacies, shape sustainability transitions in the Orinoquía and can inform more tailored policy interventions for frontier livestock regions.
abstract_zh: 奥里诺基亚地区是哥伦比亚主要的农业边疆之一，长期武装冲突动态持续影响着土地治理、生产者激励和投资决策。推动可持续畜牧业发展的努力聚焦于两项关键实践：可持续牧场管理（包括轮牧系统）和生态适宜载畜率。然而，由于制度、经济和生物物理条件的制约，这些实践的采纳程度差异显著。本研究采用二元选择框架，分析这两项实践的采纳决策，并评估其是顺序推进还是独立进行。结果表明，通过正式土地所有权衡量的产权保障与可持续牧场管理的采纳密切相关。相反，技术援助的获取与采纳呈负相关，暗示项目质量、目标定位或反向因果问题。年龄较大、经验更丰富的生产者采纳意愿较低，体现了路径依赖效应。在载畜率决策中，轮牧和交替放牧系统达到可持续阈值的概率较低，这反映了粗放型系统中的实施挑战。较大的育肥区域往往管理更不可持续，描述性证据表明，样本中不可持续载畜更常表现为载畜不足而非过度载畜，239名生产者（70%）的载畜率低于每公顷1头。这些发现揭示了结构性及制度条件（包括与冲突遗留问题相关的条件）如何塑造奥里诺基亚地区的可持续转型，并为针对边疆畜牧区域制定更精准的政策干预提供依据。

title: An Empirical Model of Quantity Discounts with Large Choice Sets
title_zh: 大选择集下数量折扣的实证模型
title_primary: 大选择集下数量折扣的实证模型
title_secondary: An Empirical Model of Quantity Discounts with Large Choice Sets
authors: Alessandro Iaria, Ao Wang
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We introduce a Generalized Nested Logit model of demand for bundles that can be estimated sequentially, eliminating the challenge of dimensionality due to large choice sets. We use it to investigate quantity discounts for carbonated soft drinks by simulating a counterfactual with linear pricing. The prices of small-volume UPCs (<2L) decrease by −29.2% while those of large-volume UPCs (≥2L) increase by +16.8%. Purchased quantities decrease by −19.5% and industry profit by −6.3%. Consumer surplus however reduces only moderately, suggesting that a ban on quantity discounts on sugary drinks may be a simple and effective policy to limit added sugar intake. Our calculations confirm that such a ban would be as effective as a sugar tax of 1.5/oz of added sugar and reduce added sugar intake by −17.4%. A nested logit model that mistakenly ignores joint purchases of UPCs within shopping trips would instead simulate a reduction in added sugar intake of only −3.9%.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一种广义嵌套Logit需求模型，用于估计捆绑商品的需求，该模型可通过序贯估计方法解决因选择集过大带来的维度问题。我们利用该模型研究碳酸饮料的数量折扣问题，通过模拟线性定价的反事实情景发现：小容量UPC（<2升）价格下降29.2%，而大容量UPC（≥2升）价格上涨16.8%。购买量减少19.5%，行业利润下降6.3%，但消费者剩余仅温和下降，这表明禁止含糖饮料的数量折扣可能是限制添加糖摄入的简单有效政策。我们的计算证实，该禁令的效果相当于对每盎司添加糖征收1.5美分的糖税，可使添加糖摄入量减少17.4%。若错误采用忽略购物行程中UPC联合购买的嵌套Logit模型，则模拟得出的添加糖摄入量降幅仅为3.9%。

title: Ballots, budgets and bricks: Brexit and the polarisation of individual economic behaviours
title_zh: 选票、预算与砖块：英国脱欧与个体经济行为的极化
title_primary: 选票、预算与砖块：英国脱欧与个体经济行为的极化
title_secondary: Ballots, budgets and bricks: Brexit and the polarisation of individual economic behaviours
authors: Pei Kuang, Davide Luca, Zhiwu Wei
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Does political polarisation influence actual economic behaviours? Using British nationally representative surveys and administrative data, we document how the Brexit referendum triggered stark divergences in individual micro and macro expectations between Leave and Remain supporters. Compared to existing research, we show how these polarising effects were driven by a specific policy issue and mostly unrelated to traditional partisan identities. We also demonstrate howthese diverging beliefs influenced major real financial decisions. Leavers became more likely to purchase durable goods and engage in housing transactions, and areas with higher proportions of Leave voters experienced increased housing transaction volumes and rising prices.
abstract_zh: 政治极化是否会影响实际经济行为？利用英国全国代表性调查与行政数据，我们记录了脱欧公投如何引发脱欧派与留欧派在个人微观及宏观预期上的显著分歧。与现有研究相比，我们揭示了这些极化效应是由特定政策议题驱动，且与传统党派身份关联不大。我们还证明了这些分歧信念如何影响重大实际财务决策。脱欧派更倾向于购买耐用消费品并参与住房交易，而脱欧选民比例较高的地区则经历了住房交易量增加和价格上涨。

title: Humidity and work-related accidents
title_zh: 湿度与工伤事故
title_primary: 湿度与工伤事故
title_secondary: Humidity and work-related accidents
authors: Nicolò Barbieri, Edoardo Santoni, Margherita Scarlato
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Analyzing almost 2.3 million work-related injuries in Italy, we estimate that higher humidity levels significantly increase the number of workplace accidents. Using dew point temperature to capture the moisture content of the atmosphere, our results confirm that a 1 °C increase in the dew point temperature raises the number of accidents by 0.7%. Allowing for non-linear effects of humidity, we uncover a U-shaped relationship highlighting that both low and high humidity levels are associated with a higher number of accidents relative to intermediate conditions.
abstract_zh: 通过分析意大利近230万起工伤事故，我们发现湿度水平升高显著增加了工作场所事故的数量。利用露点温度来捕捉大气中的水分含量，我们的结果证实，露点温度每上升1°C，事故数量增加0.7%。考虑湿度的非线性效应后，我们揭示了一种U型关系，表明相对于中等湿度条件，低湿度和高湿度水平都与更多的事故相关联。

title: Accounting for animal health in efficiency analysis: An application to Swedish dairy farms
title_zh: 效率分析中动物健康的考量：以瑞典奶牛场为例
title_primary: 效率分析中动物健康的考量：以瑞典奶牛场为例
title_secondary: Accounting for animal health in efficiency analysis: An application to Swedish dairy farms
authors: Frederic Ang, Enoch Owusu‐Sekyere, Karin Alvåsen, Helena Hansson
abstract: Abstract Poor animal health is a central concern in modern livestock production. Despite the necessity to incorporate animal health in efficiency analysis, the theoretical and empirical developments are limited on this subject. This article appropriately characterizes the axiomatic properties of animal health within a production framework. We treat animal health as a weakly disposable output with characteristics of an input and an output, which permits computing animal health‐adjusted efficiency measures and shadow prices of animal health. The application considers 980 observations of Swedish dairy farms over the years 2009–2016. We use a Benefit‐of‐the‐Doubt approach for assessing animal health, which captures its multiple dimensions with weights being optimized for each farmer. Applying a random sample‐split procedure within a Data Envelopment Analysis framework, we statistically verify the extent to which inclusion of animal health in the production framework changes the efficiency estimates. The results show that including animal health in production analysis increases the average efficiency estimates from 0.900 to 0.973, a finding that largely also holds in a statistical sense. The shadow prices of animal health are mostly positive, which indicates a general willingness to accept lower levels of production for higher levels of animal health. Our findings suggest the importance of incorporating animal health into efficiency analysis.

title: Interaction between formal punishment institution and informal centralized punishment institution
title_zh: 正式惩罚制度与非正式集中惩罚制度之间的互动
title_primary: 正式惩罚制度与非正式集中惩罚制度之间的互动
title_secondary: Interaction between formal punishment institution and informal centralized punishment institution
authors: Wei Wang, Yu Yao
abstract: Human beings often combat the free-riding tendency by establishing punishment institutions in social dilemmas. This paper investigates the interaction between formal and informal punishment institutions and explores how their combination affects cooperation. The experiment incorporates the Formal Punishment Treatment (FT), Informal Punishment Treatment (IPT), and their combination (F&IPT) to analyze their impact on contributions to public goods. The results show that the combination of formal and informal punishment (F&IPT) leads to significantly higher contributions compared to both the formal punishment institution (FT) and the informal punishment institution (IPT) alone, demonstrating a complementary relationship between the two. This study highlights the complementary relationship between formal and informal punishment mechanisms in sustaining higher levels of cooperation in public goods provision.
abstract_zh: 人类常通过在社会困境中建立惩罚机制来遏制搭便车行为。本文研究了正式与非正式惩罚机制之间的相互作用，并探讨两者结合如何影响合作水平。实验设置了正式惩罚机制（FT）、非正式惩罚机制（IPT）及其组合机制（F&IPT），分析其对公共品贡献的影响。结果表明，正式与非正式惩罚的组合机制（F&IPT）带来的贡献水平显著高于单独使用正式惩罚机制（FT）或非正式惩罚机制（IPT），两者呈现互补关系。本研究揭示了正式与非正式惩罚机制在维持公共品供给中更高合作水平方面的互补性。

title: Impacts of natural resource traceability programs: evidence from the United States’ seafood import monitoring program
title_zh: 自然资源可追溯计划的影响：来自美国海产品进口监测项目的证据
title_primary: 自然资源可追溯计划的影响：来自美国海产品进口监测项目的证据
title_secondary: Impacts of natural resource traceability programs: evidence from the United States’ seafood import monitoring program
authors: Kaitlyn L. Malakoff, Kailin Kroetz, Benjamin E. Fissel
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: International trade in natural resource commodities has been tied to declining socio-environmental conditions in production locations. Increasingly, governing bodies have turned to unilateral traceability programs to harmonize environmental and social standards at the production local with those of the importer. The United States’ Seafood Import Monitoring Program (SIMP) is one such program that covers the largest seafood import market by value and aims to reduce imports of seafood products from Illegal, Unreported, and Unregulated fishing or that are fraudulently labeled. We evaluate the impact of the SIMP on import prices as an indicator of program costs and supply chain changes. Comparing observed import prices to forecasts of counterfactual prices in a causal impact framework, we find an average 13.55% increase in import price, or a lower bound $411 million increase in import value, in the first year of implementation. Examining potential heterogeneity, we find variation in the timing of impact across processed and unprocessed products. Impact also differs across species groups. Observed significant price increases for some tunas and crustaceans likely reflect cost pass-through and changes to sourcing decisions aligned with program goals. Our findings suggest that unilateral traceability programs can be costly but support socio-environmental sustainability.

title: Monetary Policy Shocks and Exchange Rate Dynamics in Small Open Economies
title_zh: 小型开放经济体中的货币政策冲击与汇率动态
title_primary: 小型开放经济体中的货币政策冲击与汇率动态
title_secondary: Monetary Policy Shocks and Exchange Rate Dynamics in Small Open Economies
authors: Madison Terrell, Qazi Haque, Jamie L. Cross, Firmin Doko Tchatoka
abstract: This paper investigates whether the effects of monetary policy shocks on real exchange rates have changed over time and, if so, whether these changes stem from shifts in transmission mechanisms or from variation in the volatility of the shocks themselves. Using a time‐varying parameter VAR with stochastic volatility for six small open economies, we first show that a constant‐parameter VAR with stochastic volatility provides the best fit to the data in all six cases. We then employ an identification strategy that combines short‐ and long‐run restrictions to isolate monetary policy shocks, and we evaluate its robustness using high‐frequency monetary policy surprises as external instruments. Our results support Dornbusch's overshooting hypothesis in most countries. However, uncovered interest parity is frequently violated, as foreign excess returns diverge from zero following monetary policy shocks. Finally, we document a substantial decline in the volatility of monetary policy shocks since the 1990s, leading to a reduced contribution to exchange rate and macroeconomic fluctuations.

title: Public lands and urban quality of life
title_zh: 公共土地与城市生活质量
title_primary: 公共土地与城市生活质量
title_secondary: Public lands and urban quality of life
authors: Sherzod B. Akhundjanov, Paul M. Jakus
abstract: Abstract Federal and state‐owned public lands occupy a significant proportion of many U.S. urban regions, contributing to two highly‐valued, nontradable goods: viewscapes and outdoor recreational opportunities. Yet, public lands have not been adequately addressed in the urban quality‐of‐life (QOL) literature. We argue that much of the previous literature has (1) used a geographic level of aggregation that has not been extensive enough to capture all the public lands that influence wage and housing equilibria, (2) often defined public lands measures too narrowly and has excluded over 50% of public land influencing hedonic equilibria, and (3) has rarely attempted to control for public lands endogeneity when quasi‐experimental approaches are infeasible. Using GIS and Census data for U.S. urban areas, along with instruments rooted in the 19th century land disposal policies, we estimate how publicly owned federal and state lands contribute to urban QOL. Our preferred specifications are based on Bureau of Census defined Combined Statistical Areas that are linear in public land variables, and the results are robust regardless of geographic aggregation and model specification. Welfare calculations indicate that the annual urban household willingness‐to‐pay estimate for a one percent increase in public land ranges between $80.58 and $130.29. Our study contributes to the literature by establishing land grant railroads as an exogenous instrument for public lands and by providing a framework for evaluating the welfare consequences of proposed land exchanges and other changes in land ownership or management.

title: Is Hypertension Screening Effective in a Low-Resource Setting? A Multidimensional Regression Discontinuity Design
title_zh: 低资源环境下高血压筛查是否有效？基于多维断点回归设计
title_primary: 低资源环境下高血压筛查是否有效？基于多维断点回归设计
title_secondary: Is Hypertension Screening Effective in a Low-Resource Setting? A Multidimensional Regression Discontinuity Design
authors: Fabrice Kämpfen, Owen O’Donnell, Carlos Riumalló Herl, Xavier Gómez-Olivé
abstract: Noncommunicable diseases impede development, yet evidence on screening in low-resource settings is scarce. We evaluate hypertension screening in rural South Africa using a multidimensional regression discontinuity: a survey measures blood pressure (BP) and refers individuals exceeding either of two thresholds. Overall, referral modestly raises treatment uptake but shows no average BP effect after 4 years. We use BP variation with time of day and temperature to identify screens that are less likely to produce false positives. For these, referrals lower systolic BP by 5 mm Hg and uncontrolled BP by 22 percentage points. Limiting false positives may increase referral impact and program cost-effectiveness.

title: Learning Camp, Language of Instruction, and Education Outcomes: Evidence from a Field Experiment in Malawi
title_zh: 学习营、教学语言与教育成果：来自马拉维田野实验的证据
title_primary: 学习营、教学语言与教育成果：来自马拉维田野实验的证据
title_secondary: Learning Camp, Language of Instruction, and Education Outcomes: Evidence from a Field Experiment in Malawi
authors: Hyuncheol Bryant Kim, Seonghoon Kim
abstract: We conducted a randomized experiment to study the impacts of a summer learning camp and the language of instruction on education outcomes. The program, covering social studies and mathematics, provided additional high-quality learning time for 4th and 5th graders in Malawi. The program significantly increased test scores in social studies and mathematics (0.24–0.36 standard deviations). We find suggestive evidence that the impact on test scores in social studies was greater for students instructed in Chichewa, the local language, than for those instructed in English. However, we find no such evidence of differential impacts on test scores in mathematics by the language of instruction.
abstract_zh: 我们开展了一项随机实验，研究暑期学习营及教学语言对教育成果的影响。该项目涵盖社会研究和数学课程，为马拉维四、五年级学生提供了额外的高质量学习时间。实验结果显示，该项目显著提升了学生在社会研究和数学方面的测试成绩（效应量为0.24–0.36个标准差）。我们初步发现，以当地语言奇契瓦语授课的学生在社会研究测试成绩上的提升幅度大于以英语授课的学生。然而，在数学测试成绩方面，未发现教学语言导致差异化影响的证据。
